name: 62906 · Anna, IL
findings: ZIP 62906 (Anna) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62906 (Anna) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
